title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Tribulant…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Tribulant Software Newsletters (newsletters-lite) versions up to 4.18.2. This vulnerability involves improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing attackers to inject malicious scripts that can execute in users' browsers. The issue is classified as CWE-79 and has a CVSS v3.1 score of 7.1, indicating a high severity risk.
